_note: Fictional sample data. All companies, people and systems are invented.
name: Voyant T&E — Corporate Card Feed Integration
description: Voyant is a fictional travel & expense platform. This initiative integrates a daily corporate card transaction feed from Meridian Card Services and itinerary data from the SkyLane booking partner, so card transactions are auto-matched to trips and expense reports.

systems.name: Meridian Card Feed
systems.description: Partner SFTP drop of daily card transaction files (fixed-width format).

systems.name: SkyLane Booking API
systems.description: Partner REST API with trip and itinerary data.

systems.name: Voyant Expense Service
systems.description: Core service that stores expense lines and reports.

systems.name: Voyant Matching Engine
systems.description: Rules service that links transactions to trips and expense lines.

systems.name: Voyant Notification Service
systems.description: Sends email and in-app notifications to travellers.
